messages.subject: GMRF in inla
parts:
Is GMRF functions included in the INLA r package ? Do I have a choice to build a GMRF model without 
doing Laplace approximation within R ?  
Thank you. 
Nitai Mukhopadhyay
Virginia Commonwealth University.

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: GMRF in inla
parts:
Hi!

Are you asking if there are functions in the package for general calculations with GMRF models?
No, the package does not provide an interface for general model calculations, except for the new SPDE based spatial models, where a rudimentary interface is available.  That code is however not yet documented, as it is work in progress.  General access to model calculations is on the wishlist for possible future enhancements.

/Finn
